plan.purpose: Diagnose existing results, including long/short, years, profit concentration, duration, scale mismatch and correlated market episodes. No parameter search.
plan.primary: The two previously fixed original configurations on all six assets, with both full histories and the same six-year period. Hindsight asset winners shown separately only to explain the prior table.
plan.interventions: Exactly 24 direction-only six-year diagnostic reruns (six assets x two fixed parameter sets x long-only/short-only). Opposite signals still exit. Compare trade timing/returns with the corresponding side of the unchanged both-side trace. These are explanatory interventions, not newly selected strategies.
plan.features: Pre-entry completed-candle width%, prior96-bar efficiency (<.1/.1-.25/>.25), prior30-day return (<-10%/-10..10%/>10%), signal candle body fraction (<1/3,1/3..2/3,>2/3), relative volume (<1/1..2/>2). Prespecified descriptive bins, no threshold optimization, no future entry data.
plan.concentration: Trade groups use equal-principal return sums and exact additive log growth, with compounded side-only returns stated separately. Remove top10/top1%/top5% winners and top1/top3 months arithmetically, no retimed entries. Losing/winning month correlation and top10 overlap use the common six years.
plan.years: Calendar years from marked account equity; 2020/2026 or first/last years partial. Also retain Sep10 anniversary years. No forced annual liquidation. Side trade groups by close year can differ from marked year returns across the boundary.
plan.cautions: All descriptive associations are hindsight; observed holding duration is not an available entry filter. Intrabar exit duration is rounded to candle start (actual may be up to15min longer). Recorded profit peak excludes unknown extrema after an intrabar exit. Market OHLC gaps retained, no invented bars. Monthly correlations are not independent cross-asset validation. No fees/slippage/leverage; current equity reinvested as requested.
plan.fixed_grid_support: Retain last study all64 profitable counts; no new parameter combinations.
plan.scope: No live trades, downloads, changed original source or engine, no newly chosen stop/entry rule.
